steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Automation uses control systems to operate equipment with minimal human intervention, improving consistency and reducing cost. | Key Fact: Industrial robots perform repetitive, precise or hazardous tasks: welding, painting, assembly and material handling. | Key Fact: CAD/CAM integration links design directly to manufacture: a CAD model generates CNC code automatically, reducing errors and lead time. | Key Fact: Industry 4.0 connects machines, sensors and systems through IoT for data-driven manufacturing.
